# Ankur Soni

> Full-stack software engineer with 10+ years of experience building web and mobile applications. Senior Software Engineer at Amazon (Cupertino, California), specializing in AI/ML integration, educational platforms, and e-commerce solutions.

## About
- Current role: Senior Software Engineer, Amazon, Cupertino, California
- Experience: 10+ years in full-stack development; previous roles across the San Francisco Bay Area, San Jose, Boise (Idaho), and Gurgaon (India)
- Education: Kurukshetra University (2006–2010)
- Focus areas: AI/ML integration, children's education technology, e-commerce, business automation
- Location: San Francisco Bay Area, California, USA

## Projects
- [KidsVerse / FamilyHearts](https://www.familyhearts.fun): AI-powered interactive storytelling platform for children, with real-time story generation and personalized child profiles.
- [Jide](https://jide-five.vercel.app): AI-powered lead-generation and CRM chatbot for real estate brokers.
- [Rhythm & Ocean](https://rhythmocean.vercel.app): Kids clothing e-commerce platform with an AI-powered virtual try-on feature.
- [ContentAI Pro](https://v0-ai-powered-content-generator-rho.vercel.app): AI content generation platform for SEO-optimized blog posts, social captions, and product descriptions.
- [STOCK'er](https://sentiment-app-ten.vercel.app): Real-time AI-powered stock market sentiment tracker.
- [InsightCanvas](https://gen-ui-insights.vercel.app): AI research platform combining Perplexity search with Grok AI visualizations.
